tech.name: Hand-Held Torch
tech.description: Lights up dark areas and keeps you warm. Can also be used for close-range combat in a pinch. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Primitive Workbench
tech.description: Primitive Workbench for producing simple items. Pals with Handiwork suitability help speed up production.

tech.name: Stone Axe
tech.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from stone, it's not very sharp.

tech.name: Stone Pickaxe
tech.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.

tech.name: Wooden Club
tech.description: A Wooden Club for close range combat. Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.

tech.name: Campfire
tech.description: Used to make simple food or provide meager warmth and light.

tech.name: Pal Dressing Facility
tech.description: Pal Dressing Facility. Give your Pals a new look! Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

tech.name: Pal Sphere
tech.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. This basic model is only effective on low level Pals.

tech.name: Palbox
tech.description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. The area around this structure will become your base.

tech.name: Repair Bench
tech.description: Repairs damaged weapons and tools.

tech.name: Wooden Chest
tech.description: Used to store items. Place at a base and Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

tech.name: Wooden Structure Set
tech.description: Set for building bases using wood. Allows building of wooden foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

tech.name: Arrow
tech.description: Arrows for use with bows. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Global Palbox
tech.description: A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals and allows you to reconstruct them from this data. The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

tech.name: Old Bow
tech.description: Primitive long-range weapon. Hastily put together, it isn't very powerful. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Shoddy Bed
tech.description: Human bed. Sleeping restores Health. Sleep at night and time will pass until morning. Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.

tech.name: Stone Spear
tech.description: Useful for close-range combat. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

tech.name: Straw Pal Bed
tech.description: Pals at base recover SAN when sleeping in beds at night. Without a Pal Bed, Pals cannot sleep soundly, and no SAN is recovered.

tech.name: Cloth
tech.description: Cloth woven from Wool. Required to create armor. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Cloth Outfit
tech.description: Clothes made from Cloth. Protects against cold nights. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Common Shield
tech.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repair itself after not taking damage for a while.

tech.name: Feed Box
tech.description: Place food here, and Pals at the base will eat from it.

tech.name: Berry Plantation
tech.description: Can produce berries at a base. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

tech.name: Normal Parachute
tech.description: A glider for soaring through the air. Cheaply made, it isn't very fast.

tech.name: Ranch
tech.description: Ranch for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign Pals with the appropriate work suitability to the ranch to automatically produce items.

tech.name: Wooden Living Room Furniture Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Place furniture in your living space and enjoy life with your Pals.

tech.name: Wooden Tavern Cabinet Furniture Set
tech.description: Set of wooden cabinets that look at home in a tavern. Can store items.

tech.name: Wooden Tavern Furniture Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Set up a bar and enjoy life with your Pals.

tech.name: Fire Arrow
tech.description: Fire Arrows for use with bows. Deals damage on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Foxparks' Harness
tech.description: Harness for holding Foxparks. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks and attack using it as a flamethrower.

tech.name: Houseplant Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Place plants around your base for a splash of color.

tech.name: Mounted Torch
tech.description: Place it at a base to light the surrounding area.

tech.name: Pal Gear Workbench
tech.description: Produces items that allow Pals to use Partner Skills.

tech.name: Rushoar Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Rushoar.

tech.name: Sign
tech.description: Can be written on.

tech.name: WallSignBoard
tech.description: A signboard to write on. Can be hung on walls.

tech.name: Alarm Bell
tech.description: Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base. Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

tech.name: Bat
tech.description: Baseball bat for close-range combat. Might be tough to get a home run with a Pal.

tech.name: Logging Site
tech.description: Can produce wood at a base. Requires Pal with Lumbering suitability.

tech.name: Melpaca Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Melpaca.

tech.name: Monitoring Stand
tech.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

tech.name: Sandbag
tech.description: Pals assigned to it will watch for approaching enemies.

tech.name: Stone Pit
tech.description: Can produce stone at a base. Requires Pal with Mining suitability.

tech.name: Wall-Mounted Houseplant Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Place plants on your base's walls for a splash of color.

tech.name: Crusher
tech.description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

tech.name: Fireplace Set
tech.description: Brick fireplace set to provide illumination. Must be lit with fire.

tech.name: Hanging Trap
tech.description: Catches Pals that pass through. Only effective on small Pals and humans.

tech.name: Poison Arrow
tech.description: Poison Arrows for use with bows. Afflicts target with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/> on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Wooden Defensive Wall
tech.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from wood, it breaks easily.

tech.name: Wooden Gate
tech.description: Wooden gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

tech.name: Carpet Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Place on a foundation in your base for that homey feel.

tech.name: Direhowl's Saddled Harness
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Direhowl.

tech.name: Hot Spring
tech.description: Pals recover SAN while in a Hot Spring.

tech.name: Small Feed Bag
tech.description: A small pouch for holding food. Unlocks a food slot in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

tech.name: Statue of Power
tech.description: Make offerings to enhance the stats of the Player and their Pals.

tech.name: Tropical Outfit
tech.description: A Cloth Outfit produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Tundra Outfit
tech.description: A Cloth Outfit produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Antique Storage Set
tech.description: Antique storage furniture set. Can store items.

tech.name: Bear Trap (Small)
tech.description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on small Pals or humans.

tech.name: Egg Incubator
tech.description: Place a Pal Egg inside to incubate it.

tech.name: Feathered Hair Band
tech.description: A beautiful feathered headband. Though improbable, it somehow seems to protect its wearer from lethal head injuries. Can be crafted at Workbench.

tech.name: Ladder
tech.description: A ladder that allows you to climb to a slightly higher place.

tech.name: Nail
tech.description: Necessary for building various facilities. Can be made with a Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Primitive Furnace
tech.description: Uses Ore to produce Ingots.

tech.name: Three Shot Bow
tech.description: An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously. By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single Arrow when fired.

tech.name: Antique Chair Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Use with an antique desk.

tech.name: Chillet Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Chillet.

tech.name: High-Quality Workbench
tech.description: Produces faster than Primitive Workbench. Requires Pal with Handiwork trait.

tech.name: Lifmunk's Submachine Gun
tech.description: Submachine gun made specifically for Lifmunk. Activate its Partner Skill, and Lifmunk will ride on your head and fire at enemies.

tech.name: Metal Axe
tech.description: A metal axe capable of cutting down even hard trees. Effective against the sturdy trees that grow deep within the continent. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Metal Pickaxe
tech.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from metal, its durability and efficiency have improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Rayne Syndicate Flag Set
tech.description: Rayne Syndicate Standard and Rayne Syndicate Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Rayne Syndicate.

tech.name: Eikthyrdeer Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer.

tech.name: Faux Greenery Set
tech.description: A decorative artificial tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

tech.name: Grappling Gun
tech.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. It allows for easy movement between places with varying elevation.

tech.name: Meat Cleaver
tech.description: Knife for butchering Pals. When equipped, the Pet command becomes Butcher. Butchered Pals will be gone for good.

tech.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
tech.description: Can produce simple medicine. Requires Pal with Medicine Production trait.

tech.name: Pelt Armor
tech.description: Armor made from Leather. Its warmth and defense have been improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Tanzee's Assault Rifle
tech.description: Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee. Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee will enter gunner mode and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

tech.name: Tidy Table Set
tech.description: A neat decorative table set for building a clean and well-kept base.

tech.name: Antique Storage Cabinet Set
tech.description: Antique storage cabinet set. Can store items.

tech.name: Cooler Box
tech.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

tech.name: Crossbow
tech.description: Fires an Arrow effortlessly. Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Metal Chest
tech.description: Can be used to store more items. Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

tech.name: Metal Spear
tech.description: Useful for close-range combat. The metal tip gives it increased attack power. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Tanzee Ignis's Assault Rifle
tech.description: Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee Ignis. Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee Ignis will enter gunner mode and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

tech.name: Training Dummy
tech.description: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet.

tech.name: Antique Desk Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Use with an antique chair.

tech.name: Average Feed Bag
tech.description: A decently sized pouch for holding food. Unlocks 2 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

tech.name: Faux Crimson Foliage Set
tech.description: A decorative artificial autumn tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

tech.name: Mega Sphere
tech.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

tech.name: Pal Essence Condenser
tech.description: Combines several Pals of the same type to create a higher-ranked version.

tech.name: Sphere Workbench
tech.description: Produces Spheres for capturing Pals. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

tech.name: Univolt Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Univolt.

tech.name: Wall Torch
tech.description: Place it on a wall to light the surrounding area.

tech.name: Arsox Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Arsox.

tech.name: Beginner Fishing Set
tech.description: Beginner-friendly fishing rod and bait set. Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.

tech.name: Hip Lantern
tech.description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. You can also switch its lighting mode to keep it on at all times. Just one is enough to find your way in the dark.

tech.name: Mill
tech.description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

tech.name: Nitewing Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Nitewing.

tech.name: Viewing Cage
tech.description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.

tech.name: Wheat Plantation
tech.description: Use it to grow ingredients for Bread. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

tech.name: Wooden Board
tech.description: Planks made from processed wood for easier use. More versatile than raw logs, with a wide variety of uses. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

tech.name: Antique Bath Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Can't actually be used to stay clean.

tech.name: Antique Mirror Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Essentially for making sure you look good.

tech.name: Faux Golden Foliage Set
tech.description: A decorative artificial yellow autumn tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

tech.name: Heat Resistant Pelt Armor
tech.description: A Pelt Armor produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Lockpicking Tool v1
tech.description: No key? No problem! These tools will allow you to try and pry open any treasure chest that would normally require a Copper Key.

tech.name: Mega Shield
tech.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. The new model has been improved, enhancing its defense. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Surfent Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent.

tech.name: Cooking Pot
tech.description: Can efficiently prepare more varieties of foods.

tech.name: Heater
tech.description: Warms the nearby area and protects against the cold.

tech.name: Mega Grappling Gun
tech.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Since it's upgraded, it now has greater range.

tech.name: Metal Shelf Set
tech.description: Metal shelf set. Can store items.

tech.name: Pengullet Rocket Launcher
tech.description: Rocket launcher for launching Pengullet. Activate its Partner Skill to fire Pengullet and damage enemies. After firing, Pengullet will become incapacitated.

tech.name: Piano Furniture Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Place in your base and dream about living a life of luxury.

tech.name: Primitive Sword
tech.description: A sword for close-range combat. Not bad for a battered sword. Perfect for getting up close and personal.

tech.name: Tombstone
tech.description: A gravestone that can be inscribed with text. Use it for recording purposes.

tech.name: Antique High Quality Furniture Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Gives an air of stately elegance to your base.

tech.name: Bathroom Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Can't be used for its original purpose.

tech.name: Cold Resistant Pelt Armor
tech.description: A Pelt Armor produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Cooler
tech.description: Cools the nearby area and protects against the heat.

tech.name: Mega Glider
tech.description: A glider for soaring through the air. A mass produced commercial model, it’s decently fast. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Pengullet Lux's Rocket Launcher
tech.description: Rocket launcher for launching Pengullet Lux. Activate its Partner Skill to fire Pengullet Lux and damage enemies. After firing, Pengullet Lux will become incapacitated.

tech.name: Ring of Mercy
tech.description: Pacifist's ring. The wearer's attacks will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

tech.name: Tocotoco's Gloves
tech.description: Gloves for gently holding Tocotoco. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Tocotoco and use it to fire explosive eggs.

tech.name: Breeding Farm
tech.description: Assign a male and a female Pal to produce eggs. Cake is required for breeding.

tech.name: Cement
tech.description: Cement used for creating structures and more. Can be produced in a High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Grintale Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Grintale.

tech.name: Heavy Weight Module
tech.description: Equipping it makes the sphere heavier, reducing its range but increasing its capture power.

tech.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
tech.description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

tech.name: Stone Defensive Wall
tech.description: Large defensive wall that protects from enemy invasions.

tech.name: Stone Gate
tech.description: Stone gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

tech.name: Stone Structure Set
tech.description: Set for building bases using stone. Allows building of stone foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

tech.name: Antique Couch Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Gives the air of luxury to your base.

tech.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
tech.description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

tech.name: Elphidran Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Elphidran.

tech.name: Free Pal Alliance Flag Set
tech.description: Free Pal Alliance Standard and Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Free Pal Alliance.

tech.name: Giga Sphere
tech.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Able to capture moderately powerful Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

tech.name: Large Toolbox
tech.description: Place in base to improve handiwork speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.name: Sweepa Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Sweepa.

tech.name: Tarantriss Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Tarantriss.

tech.name: Weapon Workbench
tech.description: Produces simple mechanical weapons. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

tech.name: Antique Dresser
tech.description: Dresser useful for giving yourself a remake. Allows players to edit their appearance.

tech.name: Bear Trap (Large)
tech.description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on large Pals.

tech.name: Coarse Ammo
tech.description: Ammo for the Musket, Makeshift Handgun, and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

tech.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer Terra.

tech.name: Flame Cauldron
tech.description: Place in base to improve fire-making speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.name: Gunpowder
tech.description: Gunpowder used to fire ammunition. Required to make bullets. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Musket
tech.description: Simple, old-fashioned gun. Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

tech.name: Tomato Plantation
tech.description: Farm for producing tomatoes. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

tech.name: Vanwyrm Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm.

tech.name: Clock Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Doesn't actually tell time.

tech.name: Flea Market (Items)
tech.description: A facility for selling items. By setting products in the sales list, you can sell items to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

tech.name: Flea Market (Pals)
tech.description: A facility for selling Pals. By setting Pals in the sales list, you can sell them to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

tech.name: High Quality Bait
tech.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved from Simple Bait to increase the chances of Pals biting the bait.

tech.name: Homeward Thundercloud
tech.description: Transports you to the nearest base. Cannot be used in dungeons and other similar locations.

tech.name: Metal Chair and Desk Set
tech.description: Decorative furniture set. Match with metal structures and enjoy life with your Pals.

tech.name: Pal Expedition Station
tech.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

tech.name: Stun Baton
tech.description: Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact. Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Vanwyrm Cryst Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm Cryst.

tech.name: Curve Module
tech.description: Equipping it causes the sphere to spin with a curved trajectory. It becomes easier to catch Pals off guard, and increases capture power.

tech.name: Faux Bamboo Set
tech.description: A decorative artificial bamboo set. Use them to create a Bamboo Grove-inspired base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

tech.name: Kingpaca Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Kingpaca.

tech.description: A large pouch for holding food. Unlocks 3 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry. Carrying one is enough.

tech.name: Metal Armor
tech.description: Armor made of metal. Somewhat heavy, but provides good defense. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Metal Helm
tech.description: A helm made of metal. A reliable piece of armor that protects your head, and all the thoughts within. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Storage Container Set
tech.description: Container furniture set. Can store items.

tech.name: Water Fountain
tech.description: Place in base to improve watering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.name: Azurobe Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Azurobe.

tech.name: Clinic
tech.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

tech.name: Dinossom Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Dinossom.

tech.name: Flower Bed
tech.description: Place in base to improve gathering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
tech.description: Pals sleep more soundly, improving the amount of Health and SAN recovered while sleeping.

tech.name: Foxparks Cryst's Harness
tech.description: Harness for holding Foxparks Cryst. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks Cryst and release freezing air to attack.

tech.description: A handgun created from spare parts. Relatively well suited for close quarters combat, but can only fire one shot before needing to reload. Crafted at Weapon Workbench.

tech.name: Medicine Rack
tech.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

tech.name: Ore Mining Site
tech.description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

tech.name: Boost Gun
tech.description: Firing this at a Pal in your team temporarily boosts that Pal's attack and defense. Firing it at an enemy deals damage instead.

tech.name: Boost Gun Ammo
tech.description: Ammo for the Boost Gun and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

tech.name: Frag Grenade
tech.description: A Frag Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing damage to enemies.

tech.description: Improved Metal Armor. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Helzephyr Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Helzephyr.

tech.name: Lettuce Plantation
tech.description: Farm for producing lettuce. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

tech.name: Lockpicking Tool v2
tech.description: No key? No problem! These tools will allow you to try and pry open any treasure chest that would normally require a Silver Key.

tech.name: Silo
tech.description: Place in base to improve planting speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.name: Surfent Terra Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent Terra.

tech.description: Antique lamp set to provide illumination. Requires electricity to light.

tech.name: Fenglope Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Fenglope.

tech.name: Human-Powered Generator
tech.description: A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy. The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

tech.name: Lamp
tech.description: Lights up dark areas at a base.

tech.name: Makeshift SMG
tech.description: A submachine gun handmade from scraps. It excels in rate of fire, but its single-shot power is low.

tech.name: Mounted Crossbow
tech.description: Assign a Pal with Handiwork suitability and it will protect a base using the crossbow.

tech.name: Polapup Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Polapup.

tech.description: Electric Pals at the base can now store electricity, allowing the use of electric facilities.

tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Azurobe Cryst.

tech.description: Lights up dark areas below at a base.

tech.description: Improved Metal Armor. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

tech.name: Sphere Assembly Line
tech.description: Creates Pal Spheres at a faster pace. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

tech.description: An accessory that increases the player's jump power when equipped.

tech.description: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Standard and Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre.

tech.name: Dazemu Saddle
tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Dazemu.

tech.description: Soft bed with improved restorative capabilities. Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.

tech.name: Handgun Ammo
tech.description: Ammo for the Handgun and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

tech.description: Place in base to improve logging speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

tech.description: Saddle for safely riding Beakon.

tech.description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. Modifications have enhanced its effectiveness even further. Can be made at Production Assembly Line.
